evidence.quote: Methods: We conducted an online survey with 131 participants to investigate the opinion of parallel application developers about the factors limiting development productivity and potential improvement strategies.
To define the research instrument, we used the GQM approach [36]

The survey research was available to participants using Google Forms from January 28th, 2022, to November 31st, 2022. During this period, we sent some reminders to the participants. After this deadline, we obtained 131 responses, representing a response percentage of around 18.37%.

We used descriptive statistics to summarize the data from the closed-ended questions. We used only the initial procedures of GT to analyze the qualitative data, specifically open coding and axial coding, without employing the full method.
To evaluate this, we perform a chi-square test, a nonparametric test used to assess whether there is a statistically significant association between two variables.
This section presents the profile of the 131 participants of this survey research, who are from 26 different countries.
Only seven participants work at companies: Google, HPE, Intel Corporation, Nvidia, Pagonxt, and Federal Service for Data Processing (SERPRO).

When creating a coding metric to evaluate parallel applications, relevant factors must be considered, including the PPI programming model and the target architecture, as each has particular characteristics that influence development effort differently.
